name: Aichi Steel Corporation
summary: Aichi Steel Corporation manufactures and sells steel materials, forged products, electronic functional materials and components, and magnetic products in Japan, the United States, Thailand, China, and internationally. The company operates through Steel Company, Stainless Steel Company, Forge Company, Smart Company, and Others segments. It offers specialty steel products, including carbon and alloy steel for machine structural use, H-shaped steel for structural use, alloy steel bolting materials for high temperature service, microalloyed and boron steel, and spring and high carbon chrome bearing steel; hot and cold work tool steel; stainless steel products, such as angle and unequal angle bar…
